note: The brand's working icon set — what /tokens/icons shows before you search. Seeded from the icons this repo actually imports across components/, app/(registry)/, hooks/, and lib/, then trimmed to the ones that carry real meaning in the UI. Read by both the app and scripts/build-hugeicons.mjs, which inlines this geometry into the manifest so the landing view needs no shard fetches. Names must be canonical package exports; the build fails loudly if one does not resolve.
